<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_RoomService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service call"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered to guest room"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian room service" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CallReceived" name="Calls room service" sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall">
      <bpmn:documentation>Guest calls room service</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:messageFlow>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Participant_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Submit_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Alcohol_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveOrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Alcohol_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier (wine waiter)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Waiter_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Waiter_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ready_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Billing_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Other_Order_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitBeforeBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Billed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service call received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Call" messageRef="Msg_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Submit_Split" name="Split after ticket submitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" name="Order includes alcoholic beverage?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveOrderSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine from cellar and prepare other alcoholic beverages">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" name="Alcohol handling merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Waiter_Split" name="Split for waiter preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth and silverware)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Waiter_Join" name="Waiter preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Food, wine and cart ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order to guest room">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Billing_Merge" name="Ready to bill">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Other_Order_Split" name="Waiter has another order to prepare or deliver?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitBeforeBilling" name="Wait before billing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit guest account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Billed" name="Guest account debited">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Submit_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Submit_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Submit_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_GiveOrderSommelier" targetRef="Task_FetchWine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_Waiter_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Waiter_Split" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Waiter_Split" targetRef="Task_NonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_Waiter_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_NonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_Waiter_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Waiter_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Other_Order_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Other_Order_Split" targetRef="Task_WaitBeforeBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_WaitBeforeBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Other_Order_Split" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_Billed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
